evidence.quote: International students have the option of completing their entire degree program in English.
Deadline for applications from international students extended: 31 August 2026!

name.en: School and, where applicable, university certificates

value.quotedAs: School and, where applicable, university certificates

evidence.quote: For your application, you will usually need the following documents as digital copies: School and, where applicable, university certificates Certified translations of your certificates Proof of your language proficiency A copy of your passport CV Statement of purpose

notes: The programme's own page (hs-kl.de/.../leather-and-textile-engineering) states the deadline 'Deadline for applications from international students extended: 31 August 2026!'; the DAAD page states 'For all subsequent winter semesters: 1 April - 31 May' and 'For the next winter semester: until 31 August'. Tuition: the DAAD programme page says 'Tuition fees per semester None' – no tuition fee is stated for this programme for international students either. The application channel is uni-assist; the pages do not mention a VPD (Vorprüfungsdokumentation) for this university, so de-uni-assist was chosen. The requirements rule for foreign applicants is a soft/recommendation about the Studienkolleg pathway ('Your school-leaving qualification does not entitle you to study in Germany. In this case...' – the quote used is the nearest exact EU/EEA bullet from the same list).

evidence.quote: Applicants whose native language is not English must have good English skills (level B2 CEFR) by the time of the application at the latest.
This can be proven by TOEIC Listening 400 and Reading 385, TOEIC Speaking 160 and Writing 150, TOEFL iBT 87, TOEFL ITP 543, IELTS 6.0, or equivalent.

note.fr: Vérifiez que votre diplôme marocain (Baccalauréat) est reconnu en Allemagne et si vous devez passer par le Studienkolleg et l'examen d'aptitude (Feststellungsprüfung).
note.en: Check whether your Moroccan Baccalauréat is recognized in Germany and whether you need the Studienkolleg and the Assessment Test (Feststellungsprüfung).

evidence.quote: have obtained your university entrance qualification in an EU/EEA member state
